title: Check yourself: explicit and implicit permits

questions.stem: `Shape` is declared `sealed` with `permits Circle`, and the same file also declares `Square extends Shape`. What does the page say happens?

options.text: Square is also permitted, since it shares the source file
options.says: Sharing the file permits a subclass only when there is no permits clause; the page says the two ways cannot be mixed.

options.text: Compilation fails, since the clause must list every subclass
options.says: The page: once a permits clause is present it is the complete list, and an unlisted subclass in the same file is rejected.

options.text: Square compiles, but a switch must then give a default
options.says: The page shows the declaration of Square itself failing with 'class is not allowed to extend sealed class: Shape'.
